cases.name: writes-a-case-for-changelog-line
cases.promptMarkdown:
This repository has a skill at skills/changelog-line/SKILL.md but no eval case for it yet. Write
one eval case for it at evals/changelog-line/adds-one-line/, following this repository's case
format: prompt.md, case.yaml, fixture.sh, and graders/skill-fired.md as the tool-use indicator,
plus at least one more grader file that scores the actual outcome. Do not run any network or paid
command — just author the case files.

graders.name: case-yaml-shape
graders.graderMarkdown:
This is a newly authored case.yaml for an eval case named adds-one-line, meant to test the
changelog-line skill. Score 1 only if it declares the exact schema version string "1.1", a
`context.scaffold_script` naming fixture.sh, and a name and description that plainly describe
testing the changelog-line skill's behaviour. Score 0 if the schema version is missing, wrong, or
not quoted as a string; if the scaffold script is not wired to fixture.sh; or if the description
is generic filler rather than a real statement of what the case checks.

graders.name: fixture-shape
graders.graderMarkdown:
This is a newly authored fixture.sh for an eval case testing the changelog-line skill (which
appends one line under a CHANGELOG.md "## Unreleased" heading). Score 1 only if the script is
hermetic — it contains no curl, wget, npm install, pip install, git clone, or any http:// or
https:// URL — and it ends by running `git init` and committing what it created, so the run
starts from a clean, versioned tree. Score 0 if it reaches the network in any form, never
initializes a git repository, or never commits.

graders.name: case-yaml-shape
graders.evidence:
schema_version: "1.1"
name: adds-one-line
description: Adding a changelog entry for a described bug fix should append exactly one Conventional-Commits-formatted "fix" line under the Unreleased heading, without touching the already-released entries below it.
context:
  scaffold_script: fixture.sh

graders.name: fixture-shape
graders.evidence:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

cat > CHANGELOG.md <<'EOF'
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## v1.2.0 - 2026-02-01
- feat(auth): add single sign-on support

## v1.1.0 - 2026-01-01
- feat(api): add cursor-based pagination to the search endpoint
EOF

git init -q
git add -A
git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm init

graders.name: case-yaml-shape
graders.evidence:
skill: changelog-line
description: >
  Given a plain-language bug-fix description, the skill should append exactly
  one correctly formatted line under the existing "## Unreleased" heading in
  CHANGELOG.md, leaving all other content untouched.
prompt: prompt.md
fixture: fixture.sh
graders:
  - graders/skill-fired.md
  - graders/changelog-updated.md
